definition: Current status/progress of an existing order.
inclusion_criteria: General status update; not specifically tracking, ETA, or delay.
exclusion_criteria: Tracking, delivery estimate, or late delivery.
example: Can you check my order status?

definition: Expected delivery is late or the promised window has passed.
inclusion_criteria: Customer explicitly reports a late/missed delivery.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use if only asking for location or ETA before deadline.
example: My package was due yesterday and still hasn't arrived.

definition: Customer asks when an order is expected to arrive.
inclusion_criteria: ETA, expected date, or delivery duration.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for an already-late delivery.
example: When should my package arrive?

definition: Customer wants shipment location, tracking, scans, or transit status.
inclusion_criteria: Tracking/location request without an established missed deadline.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use when the customer says the delivery is already late.
example: Where is my parcel right now?

definition: Customer wants to return a received product or asks how to start a return.
inclusion_criteria: Starting or understanding a product return.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for pre-shipment cancellation or refund status.
example: How do I return this item?

definition: Customer asks about money expected from an existing refund/return.
inclusion_criteria: Refund processing status or expected refund timing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for starting a return.
example: Has my refund been processed?

definition: Payment attempt is declined, rejected, or fails during checkout.
inclusion_criteria: Unsuccessful payment attempt.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for duplicate or already-successful charges.
example: My card payment keeps failing.

definition: Same purchase appears to have been charged more than once.
inclusion_criteria: Two or more charges for one purchase.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for a single unexpected charge.
example: I was charged twice for one order.

definition: Customer wants to stop an existing order before fulfillment/shipment.
inclusion_criteria: Cancelling a one-time order.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for returning a received item or cancelling a subscription.
example: Can you cancel my order?

definition: Received product is broken, cracked, damaged, or defective on arrival.
inclusion_criteria: Physical damage is the primary issue.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for wrong or missing items.
example: The product arrived broken.

definition: Received product does not match what was ordered.
inclusion_criteria: Wrong model, product, size, color, or variant.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use when the correct product is damaged or missing.
example: I received the wrong model.

definition: One or more ordered products are absent from a delivered package.
inclusion_criteria: Package arrived but an ordered item is missing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use when a different item was delivered.
example: One item from my order is missing.

definition: Customer cannot sign in or access their account.
inclusion_criteria: General login/access problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for explicit password recovery or suspected compromise.
example: I can't sign in to my account.

definition: Customer forgot a password or explicitly requests password recovery/reset.
inclusion_criteria: Password reset or forgotten-password request.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for generic login problems or security incidents.
example: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?

definition: Customer reports suspicious login, unauthorized change, or possible account compromise.
inclusion_criteria: Security incident or suspected unauthorized access.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for ordinary login/password problems.
example: I don't recognize this login.

definition: Customer wants to change/correct the shipping address for an order.
inclusion_criteria: Delivery-address modification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for unrelated profile changes.
example: I entered the wrong shipping address.

definition: Customer wants to stop a recurring subscription or prevent renewal.
inclusion_criteria: Recurring membership cancellation.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for subscription billing questions without cancellation intent.
example: Please cancel my subscription.

definition: Customer asks about a recurring subscription charge or billing amount.
inclusion_criteria: Subscription billing explanation/dispute.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for subscription cancellation.
example: Why was I charged for my subscription?

definition: Customer asks about a promotional code or reports a coupon/discount code problem.
inclusion_criteria: Promo-code usage, rejection, or discount not applying.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for general product pricing questions.
example: My discount code isn't working.

definition: Customer requests product features, specifications, contents, options, or compatibility information.
inclusion_criteria: Informational product question.
exclusion_criteria: Do not use for problems with a received item.
example: What features does this product have?
